C33.pattern: Your `model` defaults to `auto`, which resolves to the session model unless `agents\.overrides\.pstack-panel-3` in `settings\.json` pins something else\. Pin this seat to a third vendor when you want a genuine cross-vendor panel; leaving it on `auto` can collapse the panel to two distinct models\.
